name: detectai-chats (${environment})
description: Chats (deployment.environment = ${environment}): gRPC traffic across chat-service (api) + chat-worker roles, Mongo chat_db, Redis streams/cache. Roles split by service.name facet.

pages.name: Overview
pages.description: Combined RED per role, publish-to-ingest flow, cache health, container saturation

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS `rpm` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name IN ('chat-service', 'chat-worker') AND span.kind = 'server'
FROM Span SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error = true) AS `error %` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name IN ('chat-service', 'chat-worker') AND span.kind = 'server'
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS `p95 ms` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name IN ('chat-service', 'chat-worker') AND span.kind = 'server'
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 99) AS `p99 ms` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name IN ('chat-service', 'chat-worker') AND span.kind = 'server'
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`container.cpu.utilization`) AS `cpu %` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (`container.name` LIKE '%chat-service%' OR `container.name` LIKE '%chat-worker%')
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`container.memory.percent`) AS `mem %` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (`container.name` LIKE '%chat-service%' OR `container.name` LIKE '%chat-worker%')
FROM Metric SELECT max(chat_redis_degraded) AS `degraded` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}'

FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(chat_messages_published_total), 1 minute) AS `published/min`, rate(sum(chat_messages_ingested_total), 1 minute) AS `ingested/min`, rate(sum(chat_worker_consumed_total), 1 minute) AS `consumed/min` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name = 'chat-service' AND span.kind = 'server' FACET cases(WHERE `rpc.method` IN ('GetChat', 'GetChatHistory', 'GetUserChats') AS 'reads', WHERE `rpc.method` IN ('CreateChat', 'SaveMessage') AS 'writes', WHERE `rpc.method` = 'RenameChat' AS 'updates', WHERE `rpc.method` = 'DeleteChat' AS 'deletes') TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Metric SELECT max(chat_redis_stream_lag) AS `worst lag`, average(chat_redis_stream_lag) AS `avg lag` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Metric SELECT sum(chat_stream_pending) AS `pending total` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(chat_cache_hits_total), 1 minute) AS `hits/min`, rate(sum(chat_cache_misses_total), 1 minute) AS `misses/min` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Metric SELECT average(`container.cpu.utilization`) AS `cpu` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (`container.name` LIKE '%chat-service%' OR `container.name` LIKE '%chat-worker%') FACET `container.name` TIMESERIES 1 minute LIMIT 4

FROM Metric SELECT average(`container.memory.percent`) AS `mem` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (`container.name` LIKE '%chat-service%' OR `container.name` LIKE '%chat-worker%') FACET `container.name` TIMESERIES 1 minute LIMIT 4
FROM Metric SELECT max(chat_redis_stream_lag) AS `lag` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' FACET partition LIMIT 16
FROM Metric SELECT max(chat_stream_pending) AS `pending` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' FACET stream LIMIT 16
FROM Span SELECT count(*) AS spans FACET service.name, service.version WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name IN ('chat-service', 'chat-worker') LIMIT 20

pages.name: Service
pages.description: chat-service api deep dive: gRPC latency, throughput, cache, publish path

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS `p95 ms` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name = 'chat-service' AND span.kind = 'server' AND `rpc.method` IN ('GetChat', 'GetChatHistory', 'GetUserChats')

FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS `p95 ms` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name = 'chat-service' AND span.kind = 'server' AND `rpc.method` IN ('CreateChat', 'SaveMessage')

FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS `p95 ms` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name = 'chat-service' AND span.kind = 'server' AND `rpc.method` IN ('RenameChat', 'DeleteChat')
FROM Span SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error = true) AS `error %` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name = 'chat-service' AND span.kind = 'server'

FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 99) WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name = 'chat-service' AND span.kind = 'server' AND `rpc.method` IN ('GetChat', 'GetChatHistory', 'GetUserChats') FACET `rpc.method` TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 99) WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name = 'chat-service' AND span.kind = 'server' AND `rpc.method` IN ('CreateChat', 'SaveMessage') FACET `rpc.method` TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 99) WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name = 'chat-service' AND span.kind = 'server' AND `rpc.method` IN ('RenameChat', 'DeleteChat') FACET `rpc.method` TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS `rpm` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name = 'chat-service' AND span.kind = 'server' FACET cases(WHERE `rpc.method` IN ('GetChat', 'GetChatHistory', 'GetUserChats') AS 'reads', WHERE `rpc.method` IN ('CreateChat', 'SaveMessage') AS 'writes', WHERE `rpc.method` = 'RenameChat' AS 'updates', WHERE `rpc.method` = 'DeleteChat' AS 'deletes') TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS `slow/min` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name = 'chat-service' AND span.kind = 'server' AND duration.ms > 100 FACET cases(WHERE `rpc.method` IN ('GetChat', 'GetChatHistory', 'GetUserChats') AS 'reads', WHERE `rpc.method` IN ('CreateChat', 'SaveMessage') AS 'writes', WHERE `rpc.method` = 'RenameChat' AS 'updates', WHERE `rpc.method` = 'DeleteChat' AS 'deletes') TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Metric SELECT sum(chat_grpc_requests_total) WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' FACET status TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 4

FROM Metric SELECT sum(chat_grpc_errors_total) AS errors WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' FACET cases(WHERE method IN ('GetChat', 'GetChatHistory', 'GetUserChats') AS 'reads', WHERE method IN ('CreateChat', 'SaveMessage') AS 'writes', WHERE method = 'RenameChat' AS 'updates', WHERE method = 'DeleteChat' AS 'deletes'), code TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 16
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(chat_messages_published_total), 1 minute) AS `published/min` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(chat_sync_fallback_total), 1 minute) AS `fallback/min` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' FACET reason TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 5
FROM Metric SELECT average(chat_message_bytes) AS `avg bytes` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Span SELECT max(duration.ms) AS `max ms`, average(duration.ms) AS `avg ms`, count(*) WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name = 'chat-service' AND span.kind = 'server' FACET `rpc.method` LIMIT 20

pages.name: Service Logs
pages.description: chat-service api logs: error-first stream, volume, slow RPC

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Log SELECT timestamp, `severity.text`, message, method, code, `trace.id` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name = 'chat-service' AND `severity.text` = 'ERROR' LIMIT 100
FROM Log SELECT count(*) WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name = 'chat-service' FACET `severity.text` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10
FROM Log SELECT count(*) WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name = 'chat-service' AND `severity.text` = 'ERROR' FACET method TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10

FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS n, latest(message) AS sample, latest(`trace.id`) AS `sample trace` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name = 'chat-service' AND `severity.text` = 'ERROR' FACET method LIMIT 20

FROM Span SELECT timestamp, name, `rpc.method`, duration.ms, `trace.id` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name = 'chat-service' AND span.kind = 'server' AND duration.ms > 500 LIMIT 100

pages.name: Worker
pages.description: chat-worker deep dive: consume, batches, BulkUpsert, DLQ, stream errors

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(chat_messages_ingested_total), 1 minute) AS `ingested/min` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}'
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(chat_worker_consumed_total), 1 minute) AS `consumed/min` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}'
FROM Metric SELECT sum(chat_dlq_messages_total) AS `dlq` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}'
FROM Metric SELECT max(chat_stream_pending) AS `pending` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}'
FROM Metric SELECT average(chat_worker_batch_duration_seconds) * 1000 AS `avg ms` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' FACET stage TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 5
FROM Metric SELECT average(chat_batch_size) AS `avg batch` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Metric SELECT sum(chat_stream_errors_total) AS errors WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' FACET operation TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10
FROM Metric SELECT sum(chat_database_errors_total) AS errors WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' FACET operation TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10

FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(chat_worker_consumed_total), 1 minute) AS `consumed/min`, rate(sum(chat_messages_ingested_total), 1 minute) AS `ingested/min`, rate(sum(chat_dlq_messages_total), 1 minute) AS `dlq/min` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Metric SELECT average(go_goroutines) AS goroutines WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND `service.name` IN ('chat-service', 'chat-worker') FACET `service.name` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 5

pages.name: Worker Logs
pages.description: chat-worker logs: consume, BulkUpsert, DLQ, recovery

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Log SELECT timestamp, `severity.text`, message, stream, `trace.id` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name = 'chat-worker' AND `severity.text` = 'ERROR' LIMIT 100
FROM Log SELECT count(*) WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name = 'chat-worker' FACET `severity.text` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10
FROM Log SELECT count(*) WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name = 'chat-worker' AND `severity.text` = 'ERROR' FACET message TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10

FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS n, latest(message) AS sample, latest(`trace.id`) AS `sample trace` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name = 'chat-worker' AND `severity.text` = 'ERROR' FACET message LIMIT 20

FROM Span SELECT timestamp, name, `db.operation`, duration.ms, `trace.id` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service.name = 'chat-worker' AND `db.operation` = 'bulk_upsert' AND duration.ms > 1000 LIMIT 100

pages.name: Infra
pages.description: Mongo + Redis datastore depth: op latency, cache behavior, exporter saturation, collector pipeline

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS `p95 ms` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND `db.system` = 'mongodb'
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS `p95 ms` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND `db.system` = 'redis'
FROM Metric SELECT (sum(chat_cache_hits_total) / (sum(chat_cache_hits_total) + sum(chat_cache_misses_total) + 1)) * 100 AS `hit %` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}'
FROM Metric SELECT max(redis_connected_clients) AS `redis clients` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}'
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND `db.system` = 'mongodb' FACET `db.operation` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 4
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND `db.system` = 'redis' FACET `db.operation` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 4

widgets.title: Cache read latency hit vs miss

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT average(chat_cache_op_duration_seconds) * 1000 AS `avg ms` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND operation = 'get_recent' FACET result TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 4

widgets.title: Cache read volume served vs missed

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(chat_cache_hits_total), 1 minute) AS `hits/min`, rate(sum(chat_cache_misses_total), 1 minute) AS `misses/min` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Metric SELECT average(`container.cpu.utilization`) AS `cpu`, average(`container.memory.percent`) AS `mem` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND `container.name` LIKE '%mongo%' TIMESERIES 1 minute

FROM Metric SELECT average(`container.cpu.utilization`) AS `cpu`, average(`container.memory.percent`) AS `mem` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND `container.name` LIKE '%redis%' TIMESERIES 1 minute
FROM Metric SELECT average(redis_connected_clients) AS clients, max(redis_memory_used_bytes / 1000000) AS `mem MB` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(redis_evicted_keys_total), 1 minute) AS `evicted/min`, rate(sum(redis_expired_keys_total), 1 minute) AS `expired/min` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(`container.network.io.usage.rx_bytes`), 1 minute) AS `rx`, rate(sum(`container.network.io.usage.tx_bytes`), 1 minute) AS `tx` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (`container.name` LIKE '%mongo-chat%' OR `container.name` LIKE '%redis-chat%') FACET `container.name` TIMESERIES 1 minute LIMIT 4

FROM Span SELECT max(duration.ms) AS `max ms`, average(duration.ms) AS `avg ms`, count(*) WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND `db.system` IN ('mongodb', 'redis') FACET `db.system`, `db.operation` LIMIT 20

FROM Metric SELECT sum(otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans) AS accepted, sum(otelcol_receiver_refused_spans) AS refused, sum(otelcol_exporter_sent_spans) AS sent, sum(otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans) AS failed WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO
